notes: Native GTK4 AGPC View 0.1.0-2 for amd64, built and GUI-checked by canonical main CI. Fixes dark-theme readability with theme-matched text/surfaces, larger type, clearer input hints and borders. Native GUI checks cover light, dark and both high-contrast variants. Requires AGPC Mesh >=3.0.0-3 and <4, GTK4 >=4.8 and glibc >=2.39. Run agpc-view as the desktop user. This standalone release does not change Core/All installers, enable Mesh RUN, or establish runtime readiness. Verify MANIFEST.json.asc and SHA256SUMS.asc with the established MoteBus archive key before installing.
